assurance.scope: Independent editorial and semantic review of the frozen 50-report change set; this is not a fresh full literature review or a new verification date for unchanged claims.

method.baselineComparison: Each scoped file was read from git commit 777f49a and compared with current worktree bytes; current SHA values were recomputed independently and never accepted from the author ledger alone.
method.editedReview: All 78 changed one-line paragraph/comment units across 38 files were read in baseline/current pairs with git context and relevant unchanged report evidence. Review covered scientific scope, uncertainty, negative evidence, author claims versus reader inference, and prose quality.
method.retainedReview: The 12 retained files were checked only by exact SHA-256 identity across git baseline, current bytes, and author ledger. No fresh review of their primary-source facts is claimed.
method.protectedContent: Compared ordered sequences for numeric tokens, math spans, pipe-table lines, headings, raw URLs, Markdown destinations, and figure asset targets; also compared non-comment frontmatter bytes and trailing LF.
method.sourceEscalation: Primary sources were reopened only for suspected or explicitly exceptional wording. The authorized OmniDreams Figure 13 policy-to-strategy translation was checked against the local original figure and arXiv v2 Figure 13 context.
method.globalTests: Not used as a review criterion because unrelated writers are modifying other worktree files. A scoped git diff check found no whitespace errors.

authorizedExceptions.baselineText: 完整原图保留五个面板和断轴，橙色为 NuRec、绿色为 OmniDreams，纵轴注明三次试验均值。政策排序相同，绝对事故率并不相同。
authorizedExceptions.currentText: 完整原图保留五个面板和断轴，橙色为 NuRec、绿色为 OmniDreams，纵轴注明三次试验均值。策略排序相同，绝对事故率并不相同。
authorizedExceptions.rationale: The figure and primary text compare driving policy classes and preservation of policy ranking; 策略 is the accurate term in this autonomous-driving context. Figure number, image target, panel description, and evidence boundary are unchanged.
